summary: The release fails. All 21 numbers on the three surfaces match the claim register at the right precision. The country figures add up to the headline and the refund rate equals 27 over 57. However, the headline line in release/report.md (line 7) labels CLM-NET-REVENUE 35,741.52 as 'Gross revenue, EUR'. That figure is net of refunds; the true gross is 40,235.02. The label also contradicts the caveat under it and the dashboard card. The published report.md also differs from what src/release/build_release.py renders, which prints 'Net revenue, EUR', so the surface was changed after generation. Neit
